info.title: LearnFlow API
info.description: Every non-2xx response is JSON shaped as ErrorEnvelope: { code, message, details? }. All routes are served under /api.

sessionCookie.name: lf_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by register and login.

overdue.description: True for active tasks due before today (UTC).

version.description: The version the edit is based on; a stale version gives 409.

completionRate.description: Whole percent of tasks completed; 0 when there are no tasks.

maxUploadBytes.description: The largest file the server accepts, so clients can check before sending.

failureReason.description: Why processing failed; null unless the status is failed.

charCount.description: Characters of extracted text that were kept.

truncated.description: True when the document was longer than the limit and only charCount characters were kept.

sectionCount.description: How many sections of the document were read; 1 means it fitted a single request.

truncated.description: True when the material was cut during extraction, so the summary covers only the stored part.

sourceChars.description: Characters of the material the summary was written from.

idempotencyKey.description: Set on user messages; send it again to retry the same message.
A fresh random value per message. Reuse it only to retry that same message.

materialId.description: Null for a topic quiz, or when the material was deleted later.

sourceChars.description: Characters of the material the questions were written from.

sourcePartial.description: True when the material is longer than what was used, so the quiz covers only its leading part.

options.description: The choices, for multiple_choice questions only.

QuizQuestion.description: A question as shown before submitting: it never includes the answer.

CreateQuizRequest.description: Give exactly one of topic and materialId.

materialId.description: Null for a topic quiz, or when the material was deleted later.

sourceChars.description: Characters of the material the questions were written from.

sourcePartial.description: True when the material is longer than what was used, so the quiz covers only its leading part.

score.description: Questions answered correctly; null until submitted.

percent.description: The score as a whole percentage; null until submitted.

answer.description: multiple_choice: the index of the chosen option; true_false: true or false; short_answer: the text.

answers.description: The answers given so far (unanswered questions are absent).

results.description: Correct answers and explanations; null until the attempt is submitted.

answer.description: Null when the question was left unanswered.

correctAnswer.description: multiple_choice: the correct option index; true_false: the correct value; short_answer: the accepted answers.

AiReview.description: Judged by AI. It never changes the score.

score.description: Questions answered correctly; null until submitted.

percent.description: The score as a whole percentage; null until submitted.

saved.description: False until the user saves a setting; the values are then the defaults.

startsAt.description: A UTC instant; show it in the user's time zone.
An ISO 8601 instant with a time zone designator (Z or an offset).

endsAt.description: After the start, and at most 12 hours later.

from.description: First day of the range (YYYY-MM-DD) in the user's time zone.

to.description: Last day of the range, today, in the user's time zone.

activeInRange.description: Tasks that existed and were not yet completed at some moment of the range.

completionRate.description: Whole percent: completed divided by activeInRange; 0 when activeInRange is 0.

series.description: One entry per day of the range, zero-filled.

averageScorePercent.description: Null when no attempt was submitted in the range.

series.description: One entry per day of the range, zero-filled.

detail.description: A quiz score, or the start of a scheduled session.

A file that is accepted but cannot be read (corrupt, scanned PDF, too slow) is still created, with status failed and a failureReason. A rejected file (wrong type, empty, too large) creates nothing. post.summary: Write a new summary of a material, replacing the previous one
post.description: Needs a verified email. Reads only the stored text of the material. A long document is split into sections that are summarized one by one and then combined; sectionCount says how many. The request returns when the summary is complete. If any section fails after one retry of a timeout or outage, nothing is saved and the previous summary (if any) stays. The whole job is checked against the user quota and the global budget before it starts.

post.summary: Send a message and get the assistant's reply
post.description: Needs a verified email. The message is stored, the reply is generated, and both are returned. If generating fails the message stays stored and no reply is saved: send the same idempotencyKey again to retry it. Repeating the key of an answered message returns the stored answer without calling the provider. Limits, the configuration check, and the global budget are checked before anything is stored.

post.summary: Generate a quiz from a topic or a ready material
post.description: Needs a verified email. Every question the AI writes is checked against a strict schema; invalid ones are discarded, and one more request is made for any shortfall. If the requested number still cannot be reached the request fails with AI_BAD_RESPONSE and nothing is stored. A material quiz uses only the leading part of the material; sourcePartial says when the material is longer. The response never includes correct answers or explanations.
